data.message: I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher this month and thereafter when stock is 500. If all 25 comply, we each earn $10,000/month, leave 250 tons, and recover to 500 under either replenishment outcome. If stock drops below 500, let's coordinate a lower cap before fishing. I'll request 10 this month and support this sustainable plan; please state whether you'll do the same.
